signal: Alogent earned three 2026 PayTech Awards finalist nods and Fed authorization to directly exchange X9 check image files, expanding into payments infrastructure

email.body1:
Justin, saw Alogent landed three 2026 PayTech Awards finalist nods and just got Federal Reserve authorization to exchange X9 files directly.

Moving into payments infrastructure usually opens more banks and credit unions than the team can work before momentum cools, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alogent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Justin, quick follow-up for Alogent.

When a new capability like X9 exchange lands, the FI accounts worth chasing pile up faster than a team can cover, and most groups don't actually know how many meetings it takes to hit the new target. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alogent needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Justin, last bit of proof for Alogent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alogent's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Justin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority for Alogent this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right as you expand the payments footprint, and I know that stretch is busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your FI motion? I'll tailor it to Alogent either way.
